prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. Four adult friends aged 27 to 38 sit on a linen picnic blanket in a grassy park, passing fruit and chatting in a loose semicircle. One laughs, one listens, and two share a small smile. Use soft late-afternoon light, ordinary casual clothes, distinct natural expressions, and an eye-level environmental group photograph. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearances for exactly four people: a tall blond man with round glasses, a woman with auburn curls and freckles, a stocky dark-haired man with short stubble, and a woman with a short straight black bob and olive skin. Show ordinary distinct faces and varied body types.
Composition priority: exact wide 16:9 aspect ratio. Step the camera back to an environmental medium-wide view. ALL main people, faces, arms, hands and key props must fit entirely in the central 55 percent of image width, leaving substantial believable room or scenery at BOTH sides.
Critical scale requirement: make a VERY WIDE ESTABLISHING PHOTOGRAPH from about eight metres away with a 35mm lens, rather than a medium group shot. Keep the entire closely gathered group, ALL heads, ALL bodies, every limb and key prop inside x=28% through x=72% of frame width. The leftmost and rightmost quarters contain only environment, never people. All people must be visibly smaller within the generous surrounding scenery. Use a full coherent optical photograph, no blends or masked areas.
review: Reviewed replacement full wide image: exactly four distinct adults sit together on a picnic blanket, passing fruit and smiling. Whole group is small within a wide natural park view, with coherent hands, connected limbs and clearly separate faces. Important people and fruit interaction remain safely inside central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops. Horizontal 1672x941.
